a=np.arange(-3.,4.); l=np.arange(0.,11.,2.)
bits=((np.arange(512)[:,None]>>np.arange(9))&1).astype(float)
G=np.tile(bits,(len(a)*len(l),1)); A=np.repeat(a,len(l)*512); L=np.repeat(np.tile(l,len(a)),512)
X=np.column_stack([A,G,L]); Y=predict(X).reshape(-1); mu=Y.mean()
grids=[a]+[np.array([0.,1.]) for j in range(9)]+[l]
R=Y-mu
for i in range(11):
 vals=np.array([Y[X[:,i]==v].mean() for v in grids[i]])-mu
 R=R-vals[np.searchsorted(grids[i],X[:,i])]
print('R stats',R.mean(),R.std(),R.min(),R.max())
nodes=[(np.ones(len(R),dtype=bool),[])]
for depth in range(5):
 out=[]
 for mask,conds in nodes:
  n=mask.sum(); best=(-1,None,None,None)
  if n<100:out.append((mask,conds));continue
  for j in range(11):
   for t in grids[j][:-1]:
    left=mask&(X[:,j]<=t); nl=left.sum(); nr=n-nl
    if nl<50 or nr<50:continue
    m0=R[left].mean(); m1=R[mask&(~left)].mean()
    gain=nl*nr/n*(m0-m1)**2
    if gain>best[0]:best=(gain,j,t,left)
  if best[0]<1.:
   out.append((mask,conds));continue
  gain,j,t,left=best
  out.extend([(left,conds+[(INPUTS[j],'<',float(t))]),(mask&(~left),conds+[(INPUTS[j],'>',float(t))])])
 nodes=out
 print('depth',depth+1,'n',len(nodes),'top abs means')
 for mask,conds in sorted(nodes,key=lambda z:abs(R[z[0]].mean()),reverse=True)[:10]:
  print(round(mask.sum()/len(R),3),round(R[mask].mean(),3),round(R[mask].std(),3),conds)
